study: Kepler-69 b constant Q8-fit forecasts in independent Q10 and Q11
same_original_Q8_model: BLS scan 1.5-20.0 days, 0.09/0.15/0.24-day durations, Astropy objective snr, frequency_factor 5, 301-cadence median-normalized original NASA PDCSAP_FLUX with SAP_QUALITY zero
same_frozen_Q9_rule: For every held-out quarter, depth by Q8-fixed predicted windows, 3+ inside samples, 6+ sideband samples, sideband offsets 1.5 to 3.5 durations. Two or more valid windows, positive depth in >=60%, internal 1000 alternate-phase comparisons with empirical fraction <=0.01.
on_unavailable_data: Record missing quarter, do not substitute another quarter or target
caveats: This is an extension motivated by the already observed Q9 result, not the original Q9 frozen sample.
Results test timing of recurring dips from one known planet host, not whether dip cause is planetary.
Alternative phase comparisons are within-star and not calibrated mission-wide false-alarm probabilities.
No tuning of Q8 period or epoch on Q9, Q10, Q11
